subject: Eval incentive package for Helix Health bake-off
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@helixhealth.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP bake-off: request for evaluation credit and timeline

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Our procurement team (cc'd) is compiling the bake-off criteria. Can Redwood provide a trial credit allocation to run a 3-week head-to-head evaluation against VendorX? We're looking for 2M tokens of generation + 50k embedding units. If possible we'd like a 30-day trial window and visibility into model latency metrics.

Attached is the RFP (Helix-RFP.pdf) and the primary success metrics. We are talking to VendorX and CloudAI; to be competitive we'd need parity on trial capacity and a letter that credits are exclusive to this bake-off.

Let me know what you can do by Monday—our procurement deadline is 6/2.

Best,
Sarah Lin
CTO, Helix Health
sarah@helixhealth.ai

Attachments: Helix-RFP.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: RFP bake-off: request for evaluation credit and timeline

Ben/Marissa,

Forwarding Helix Health's ask. They want 2M gen tokens + 50k embeddings, 30-day window, and an exclusivity note for the bake-off parity. Deal looks like SMB-midmarket with potential Dedicated next year. HubSpot shows ARR comp is ~$350k ARR if they choose Redwood for prod (HubSpot ID: HS-34792).

Questions:
- Can we approve 2M/50k as a standard eval top-up, or do we cap at 1M/25k unless they commit to a trial/PO?
- Any previous concessions on exclusivity language? Legal typically pushes back.

Proposed compromise: Offer 1.5M gen + 40k embeddings, 30-day trial, and a one-line "not an exclusivity commitment" statement. If they sign a trial PO within 14 days we top up to 2M/50k and provide a single-week extended SLA review.

If approved, I will send the formal offer and a short MOA for signature.

Thanks,
Mateo
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Redwood eval offer and MOA for Helix Health bake-off

Hi Sarah,

Appreciate the RFP. We can offer the following promotional evaluation package:
- 1.5M generation tokens + 40k embedding units
- 30-day trial period starting on activation
- Latency & cost dashboard access for the trial (per-route breakdown)
- Top-up to 2M/50k if a trial PO is signed within 14 days of trial activation

This offer is promotional; it does not imply exclusivity and is subject to our standard MOA (attached). No SLA credits are included for the trial other than reporting.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the package and preferred trial start date (we have capacity to begin week of 6/7).
2) I will send a short MOA (attached: redwood-moa-draft.pdf) and a DocuSign link for signature.

Links & attachments:
- Attached: Helix-RFP.pdf (from you), redwood-moa-draft.pdf (MOA)
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/HS-34792
- DocuSign (preliminary): https://docusign.com/serve/ABC123

Cc'ing Marissa and Ben for ops and approval trail.

Thanks,
